title: World Data
description: Analyzes world data including LevelDB chunks, command blocks, level.dat settings, and coordinates. Identifies command usage patterns and potential issues in saved world data.

101.title: Function Command
101.description: Warning when a potentially problematic command is found in an MCFunction file. Some commands may have unintended effects in certain contexts.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the problematic command text

102.title: Block Command
102.description: Warning when a potentially problematic command is found in a command block. Some commands may cause issues when run from command blocks.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the command block command text

103.title: Min X
103.description: The minimum X coordinate of loaded chunks in the world. Used to determine world boundaries.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the minimum X coordinate as a number

104.title: Min Z
104.description: The minimum Z coordinate of loaded chunks in the world. Used to determine world boundaries.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the minimum Z coordinate as a number

105.title: Max X
105.description: The maximum X coordinate of loaded chunks in the world. Used to determine world boundaries.
105.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the maximum X coordinate as a number

106.title: Max Z
106.description: The maximum Z coordinate of loaded chunks in the world. Used to determine world boundaries.
106.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the maximum Z coordinate as a number

112.title: World Command
112.description: Warning when commands that affect the entire world are detected, such as weather, time, or gamerule commands.
112.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the world-impacting command text

121.title: Block Types
121.description: Tracks block types found in the world data for content analysis.
121.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the block type identifier

122.title: Block States
122.description: Tracks block data values and states found in the world.
122.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the block state data

123.title: Command
123.description: Tracks individual commands found in the world (from command blocks, etc.) for analysis.

124.title: Execute Subcommand
124.description: Tracks subcommands used within /execute commands for complexity analysis.
124.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the execute subcommand text

125.title: Level.dat Info
125.description: Information extracted from the level.dat file, including world settings and properties.

126.title: Experiments
126.description: Experiments enabled in the world's level.dat file.

127.title: Empty Chunks
127.description: Count of chunks that have no subchunk data. May indicate empty or corrupted chunks.
127.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of empty chunks

128.title: Chunk Count
128.description: Total number of chunks in the world.
128.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the total chunk count

212.title: Outdated Command
212.description: Warning when a command uses syntax from an older Minecraft version. Consider updating to current command syntax.
212.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the outdated command text

400.title: Processing Error
400.description: Error when the world data could not be fully processed. May indicate corruption or unsupported format.
400.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains details about the processing error

401.title: Unexpected Error
401.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing world data. Check logs for details.
